title: Affine offsets are not determined by the normal matroid
exact_object: Pairs of affine hyperplane arrangements with identical ordered normal vectors and complete subset-rank functions but different avoidance terminals
theorem: Normal-space rank/intersection data alone cannot determine affine-subspace-union avoidance or SAT/UNSAT.
claim_boundary: This rejects normal-matroid-only semantics. It does not reject affine-aware decomposition, prove unbounded affine width, or resolve P versus NP.
